name: User Preference Recall
description: Can the system remember stated preferences across topic changes?

conversation.content: I always use dark mode everywhere. Light themes give me headaches.
Noted. Many developers prefer dark mode for extended coding sessions.
Can you help me configure Neovim? I switched from VS Code last month.
Sure! Are you using lazy.nvim for plugin management?
Yes. I also strongly prefer tabs over spaces, 4-width. Non-negotiable.
Got it. I'll make sure any config suggestions use tabs with tabstop=4.
Perfect. Also, I exclusively use Rust and TypeScript. No Python for me.
Rust and TypeScript — great combo. I'll focus LSP config on rust-analyzer and typescript-language-server.
Thanks. Now, I'm setting up a new terminal emulator. What theme should I use?

query: Based on what you know about my preferences, what theme type should you recommend for my terminal?
